Laura / team —

I've reviewed Draft_DPA_ClearLine_v1.docx and scanned the subprocessors CSV. High level: acceptable with redlines. Summary of privacy/security items we should request/edit before countersignature:

1) Data deletion and return: DPA references deletion but lacks concrete timelines. Ask for confirmation: deletion within 60 days of contract termination for production customer data; backups removed within 180 days.
2) Subprocessor contract language: we need an explicit obligation for subprocessors to flow down equivalent data protection obligations. If any subprocessors are in jurisdictions lacking adequate safeguards, require SCCs or equivalent.
3) International transfers: the DPA's transfer language is vague — request standard SCCs (or other lawful mechanism) for transfers out of the EU.
4) Audit rights: ask for clarification on audit scope and frequency; prefer a right to audit within business days notice and samples rather than full audits.
5) Retention: 7 years is longer than typical for PII; suggest making retention 'as required by contract or law' and propose a 2–3 year default for general customer metadata unless an explicit legal requirement exists.

If Procurement is comfortable with these asks, I can draft redlines and a short cover memo for legal. ETA: I can produce the redline draft by end of day Tue 6/23.

Soojin Lee
Staff Privacy Counsel
